checksResults.title: accesskey values must be unique
checksResults.description: Checks that no two elements on the page share the same accesskey attribute value.

checksResults.title: <area> must have an accessible name
checksResults.description: Checks that <area> elements have a non-empty accessible name via alt, aria-label/aria-labelledby, or title.

checksResults.title: <area> text alternative must be appropriate (manual review)
checksResults.description: Flags <area> elements with a non-empty text alternative (alt, aria-label, aria-labelledby or title) for human review of appropriateness. Says when the name looks like a file name, a web address, a placeholder, an "image of" opening or is very long.

checksResults.title: aria-* attributes must be permitted for the element’s role
checksResults.description: Checks that every recognized aria-* attribute present on an element with an explicit role is either globally supported or supported by that role.

checksResults.title: Explicit role must be permitted for its host element
checksResults.description: Checks that an explicit role="" attribute is one of the roles the ARIA-in-HTML specification permits for the host element (e.g. role="tab" is not permitted on <nav>).

checksResults.title: aria-braillelabel/aria-brailleroledescription must have a non-braille equivalent
checksResults.description: Checks that elements using aria-braillelabel also have a regular accessible name, and elements using aria-brailleroledescription also have aria-roledescription.

checksResults.title: Native checkbox/radio aria-checked should match its actual state
checksResults.description: Flags a native <input type="checkbox">/<input type="radio"> whose explicit aria-checked value disagrees with its actual checked/indeterminate state, for manual review.

checksResults.title: aria-errormessage requires aria-invalid to be set to a non-false value
checksResults.description: Checks that elements with aria-errormessage also have aria-invalid set to "true", "grammar", or "spelling"; otherwise the error message is dropped from the accessibility tree.

checksResults.title: role attribute should not use a deprecated or author-discouraged ARIA role
checksResults.description: Checks that an explicit role="" attribute does not use a role deprecated by the WAI-ARIA specification, or one reserved for user-agent-internal use (e.g. role="generic").

checksResults.title: The document <body> must not be aria-hidden
checksResults.description: Checks that <body> does not have aria-hidden="true", which would remove the entire page from the accessibility tree.

checksResults.title: ARIA hidden elements must not be focusable
checksResults.description: Checks that aria-hidden="true" elements are not focusable and do not contain focusable descendants.

checksResults.title: ARIA naming attributes must not be used on roles that prohibit them
checksResults.description: Checks that aria-label/aria-labelledby are not present on WAI-ARIA roles whose specification explicitly prohibits ARIA naming (e.g. generic, emphasis, strong, paragraph).

checksResults.title: Container roles must not own a child with a disallowed role
checksResults.description: Checks that every accessible-tree-owned child of a container role (list, listbox, menu, menubar, radiogroup, rowgroup, table, grid, treegrid, tablist, tree, row) has one of that role's allowed owned roles.

checksResults.title: Roles with a required ARIA state/property must carry it
checksResults.description: Checks that elements with an explicit role carry every unambiguous, context-independent required aria-* state/property for that role (e.g. role="checkbox" must have aria-checked).

checksResults.title: Container roles must own at least one required child role
checksResults.description: Checks that container roles with a documented "required owned elements" entry (list, listbox, menu, radiogroup, table, grid, tablist, tree, row, ...) contain at least one descendant or aria-owns-referenced element with an acceptable owned role.

checksResults.title: Roles requiring a specific context role must be in that context
checksResults.description: Checks that roles with a documented "required context role" entry (listitem, option, tab, treeitem, row, cell, ...) have an ancestor or aria-owns owner with an acceptable context role.

checksResults.title: ARIA roles that require an accessible name have one
checksResults.description: Checks that the ARIA roles WAI-ARIA requires an accessible name for expose a non-empty one.

checksResults.title: role attribute must be a valid, non-abstract ARIA role
checksResults.description: Checks that an explicit role="" attribute resolves to a real, non-abstract WAI-ARIA role.

checksResults.title: role="text" elements should have no focusable descendants
checksResults.description: Checks that elements with role="text" contain no focusable descendant (link, button, form control, tabindex, iframe, or contenteditable).

checksResults.title: aria-* attributes must be real, defined ARIA attributes
checksResults.description: Checks that every aria-* attribute name present in the DOM is a real attribute defined by the WAI-ARIA specification.

checksResults.title: aria-* attribute values must match their declared type
checksResults.description: Checks that every recognized aria-* attribute has a value conforming to its WAI-ARIA-declared value type (boolean, tristate, token, integer, number, or ID reference).

checksResults.title: autocomplete attribute must be a valid autofill value
checksResults.description: Checks that a non-empty autocomplete attribute is "on"/"off" or a well-formed autofill detail token list.

checksResults.title: Inline style must not force text spacing below the WCAG metric
checksResults.description: Checks that where inline style forces line-height, letter-spacing or word-spacing with !important, the value already meets WCAG 1.4.12, so the user has nothing left to override.

checksResults.title: Binary controls have an accessible name
checksResults.description: Checks that checkbox, radio, and switch controls expose a non-empty accessible name.

checksResults.title: Buttons have an accessible name
checksResults.description: Checks that buttons expose a non-empty accessible name.

checksResults.title: Page must provide a way to bypass repeated blocks
checksResults.description: Checks that the page has at least one recognized WCAG 2.4.1 bypass-blocks mechanism: a main landmark, a working skip link, or a heading.

checksResults.title: <canvas> must provide a text alternative
checksResults.description: Checks that <canvas> elements provide a text alternative via fallback content or an accessible name.

checksResults.title: <canvas> text alternative must be appropriate (manual review)
checksResults.description: Flags <canvas> elements with a detected text alternative for human review of equivalence and appropriateness.

checksResults.title: Comboboxes have an accessible name
checksResults.description: Checks that elements with role="combobox" expose a non-empty accessible name.

checksResults.title: Color contrast is computable for rendered text
checksResults.description: Determines whether sufficient information is available to compute WCAG color contrast for visible text (e.g., no gradients/images/blend modes that make background indeterminate).

checksResults.title: Text meets enhanced color contrast (AAA)
checksResults.description: Checks that visible text has a contrast ratio of at least 7:1 (normal) or 4.5:1 (large), when contrast is computable from CSS.

checksResults.title: Text meets minimum color contrast (AA)
checksResults.description: Checks that visible text has a contrast ratio of at least 4.5:1 (normal) or 3:1 (large), when contrast is computable from CSS.

checksResults.title: Focus indicator must not be removed without a replacement
checksResults.description: Flags elements in the tab order whose focus outline is removed, by a :focus/:focus-visible rule or by a rule with no state such as a { outline: none }, with no replacement indicator (border, box-shadow, background, ...) in any focus rule matching them.

checksResults.title: Focusable elements must not be visually hidden
checksResults.description: Checks that keyboard-focusable elements are not visually hidden by CSS techniques that can leave them in the tab order.

checksResults.title: CSS must not lock the page to a single orientation
checksResults.description: Checks that no @media (orientation: portrait|landscape) rule sets a transform: rotate(...) on the page, a known technique for defeating device orientation, and asks about any such rule that hides the page's main content.

checksResults.title: Description lists must be structured correctly
checksResults.description: Checks that <dl> elements only directly contain <dt>/<dd> groups (optionally wrapped in one <div>), <script>, <template>, or <style>.

checksResults.title: Scrolling <marquee> content must be possible to pause, stop, or hide
checksResults.description: Asks, for each obsolete <marquee> element, whether the page offers a way to pause, stop, or hide its auto-scrolling content, since the element itself has none.

checksResults.title: Dialogs have an accessible name
checksResults.description: Checks that dialogs (elements with role="dialog" or role="alertdialog", and native <dialog> elements) expose a non-empty accessible name.

checksResults.title: Description-list items must be inside a description list
checksResults.description: Checks that <dt>/<dd> elements are contained by a <dl>, directly or via one wrapping <div>.

checksResults.title: IDs must be unique
checksResults.description: Checks that every non-empty id attribute value is unique within its own document or shadow tree (WCAG 2.0/2.1 SC 4.1.1, removed in WCAG 2.2).

checksResults.title: IDs referenced by ARIA must be unique
checksResults.description: Checks that any id value referenced by an ARIA ID-reference attribute (aria-labelledby, aria-describedby, aria-owns, aria-controls, aria-activedescendant, aria-flowto, aria-errormessage, aria-details) is unique in the document.

checksResults.title: <embed> must provide a text alternative
checksResults.description: Checks that <embed> elements provide a text alternative via an accessible name.

checksResults.title: <embed> text alternative must be appropriate (manual review)
checksResults.description: Flags <embed> elements with a detected name for human review of appropriateness.

checksResults.title: Headings must not be empty
checksResults.description: Checks that heading elements (<h1>-<h6> or role="heading") have a non-empty accessible name.

checksResults.title: Table header cells must not be empty
checksResults.description: Checks that table header cells (<th>, or any element with role="columnheader"/"rowheader") have visible text content. A header named only via aria-label/aria-labelledby is also flagged, since real screen-reader/browser support for that is inconsistent.

checksResults.title: Elements added to the tab order should have interactive semantics
checksResults.description: Flags elements with tabindex >= 0 whose explicit role is a non-interactive structural/document role (e.g. heading, list, note, presentation), for manual review.

checksResults.title: Form field labels should be descriptive and distinguishable
checksResults.description: Flags a visible form-field label that is a placeholder ("Label", "Field"), or that repeats another field's label with no visible context (heading, legend, or row) telling the two apart. English placeholders are always recognized, and German, Spanish, French or Japanese ones when the field is in that language.

checksResults.title: Form controls must have a programmatic label
checksResults.description: Checks that form controls have a programmatic label via <label>, aria-label, aria-labelledby, title, or placeholder.

checksResults.title: Form controls should have a label shown on screen
checksResults.description: Flags form controls whose accessible name comes from placeholder, title, aria-label, or aria-labelledby pointing only at hidden text, none of which is a label shown on screen. Prefer a visible <label>, or aria-labelledby pointing at visible text.

checksResults.title: Form controls must not have multiple labels
checksResults.description: Checks that a form control is associated with at most one <label> (by wrapping or by label[for]).

checksResults.title: Heading levels must not skip a level
checksResults.description: Checks that heading levels increase by at most one at a time in document order.

checksResults.title: Heading text should be descriptive, not a placeholder
checksResults.description: Flags headings whose accessible name is a placeholder rather than a description of the content that follows: a generic word ("Heading", "Untitled"), a numbered template slot ("Section 2"), a filename, or a URL. English phrases are always recognized, and German, Spanish, French or Japanese ones when the heading is in that language.

checksResults.title: Page language is declared
checksResults.description: Checks that the default language of the page is programmatically declared.

checksResults.title: lang and xml:lang must not disagree
checksResults.description: Checks that the <html> element's lang and xml:lang attributes declare the same primary language, when both are present.

checksResults.title: Frames with the same name embed the same resource
checksResults.description: Checks that <iframe>/<frame> elements sharing an accessible name embed the same resource, since one name can only describe one resource.

checksResults.title: Links with the same accessible name should lead to the same destination
checksResults.description: Flags groups of links that share the same accessible name but resolve to more than one distinct destination, for manual review of whether they serve the same purpose.

checksResults.title: Frames with tabindex="-1" must not contain focusable content
checksResults.description: Checks that same-origin <iframe>/<frame> elements with tabindex="-1" do not contain focusable content, which keyboard users cannot reach: the negative tabindex takes the frame’s whole content out of the tab order.

checksResults.title: Frames have an accessible name
checksResults.description: Checks that <iframe>/<frame> elements expose a non-empty accessible name via aria-label, aria-labelledby, or the title attribute.

checksResults.title: Frame title uniqueness (deprecated)
checksResults.description: Deprecated since 1.8.0 and always notApplicable: whether frames sharing a name embed the same resource is checked by identical-iframes-same-purpose.

deprecation.reason: A repeated title attribute is not a WCAG 4.1.2 violation, and identical-iframes-same-purpose already checks what ACT rule 4b1c6c asks: that frames sharing a name embed the same resource.

checksResults.title: Image alt text must not duplicate adjacent visible text
checksResults.description: Checks that an alt text is not identical to other visible text already present in its immediate parent element.

checksResults.title: Excluded //
checksResults.description: Flags , and

occurrences.hint: Add an alt attribute (use alt="" only for decorative images).

checksResults.title: must have an alt attribute
checksResults.description: Checks that elements provide an alt attribute to support a text alternative mechanism.

checksResults.title: alt text must be appropriate (manual review)
checksResults.description: Flags elements with non-empty alt text for human review of appropriateness, and says when the alt looks like a file name, a web address, a placeholder, an "image of" opening or is very long.

checksResults.title: <input type="image"> with alt="" must be appropriate (manual review)
checksResults.description: Flags <input type="image"> elements with empty alt for human review (usually not appropriate for functional controls).

checksResults.title: <input type="image"> must have an alt attribute
checksResults.description: Checks that <input type="image"> elements provide an alt attribute to support a text alternative mechanism.

checksResults.title: <input type="image"> text alternative must be appropriate (manual review)
checksResults.description: Flags <input type="image"> elements with a non-empty text alternative (alt, aria-label, aria-labelledby or title) for human review of appropriateness. Says when the name looks like a file name, a web address, a placeholder, an "image of" opening or is very long.

checksResults.title: Label in Name: accessible name contains visible text
checksResults.description: Checks that when a control has a visible text label, the accessible name contains that visible label text (WCAG 2.5.3).

checksResults.title: Title-only form labels (deprecated)
checksResults.description: Deprecated since 1.10.0 and always notApplicable: a form control labelled only by its title attribute is reported by form-control-programmatic-label-quality.

deprecation.reason: Every finding it made duplicated one form-control-programmatic-label-quality makes for the same element, which also covers placeholder-only labels.

checksResults.title: Banner landmark must be top-level
checksResults.description: Checks that the banner landmark (role="banner" or a non-nested <header>) is not nested inside another landmark region.

checksResults.title: Complementary landmark must be top-level
checksResults.description: Checks that the complementary landmark (role="complementary" or an <aside> that keeps its implicit role) is not nested inside another landmark region.

checksResults.title: Contentinfo landmark must be top-level
checksResults.description: Checks that the contentinfo landmark (role="contentinfo" or a non-nested <footer>) is not nested inside another landmark region.

checksResults.title: Main landmark must be top-level
checksResults.description: Checks that the main landmark (role="main" or <main>) is not nested inside another landmark region.

checksResults.title: Page must not have more than one banner landmark
checksResults.description: Checks that at most one banner landmark (role="banner" or a non-nested <header>) exists on the page.

checksResults.title: Page must not have more than one contentinfo landmark
checksResults.description: Checks that at most one contentinfo landmark (role="contentinfo" or a non-nested <footer>) exists on the page.

checksResults.title: Page must not have more than one main landmark
checksResults.description: Checks that at most one main landmark (role="main" or <main>) exists on the page.

checksResults.title: Page should have a main landmark
checksResults.description: Checks that the page has at least one main landmark (role="main" or <main>).

checksResults.title: Region and form roles must have an accessible name
checksResults.description: Checks that an element given role="region" or role="form" has an accessible name, without which it is not exposed as a landmark.

checksResults.title: Landmarks with the same role must have unique names
checksResults.description: Checks that when two or more landmarks share the same role, each has a distinct accessible name.

checksResults.title: Links in text blocks must be distinguishable from surrounding text without relying on color alone
checksResults.description: Checks that a link inside a run of text is visually distinguishable from the surrounding text by a non-color cue (underline, font-weight or style, border, background, icon), and asks about links distinguished only by a >=3:1 color difference, which also need a hover and focus cue.

checksResults.title: Links have an accessible name
checksResults.description: Checks that links expose a non-empty accessible name.

checksResults.title: Link text should be descriptive, not generic
checksResults.description: Flags links whose full accessible name is a known non-descriptive phrase (e.g. "click here", "read more", "more") or a bare file-format name (e.g. "HTML", "PDF") with no adjacent context naming what it leads to, for manual review of whether the purpose is clear. English phrases are always recognized, and German, Spanish, French or Japanese ones when the link is in that language.

checksResults.title: Lists must only directly contain list items
checksResults.description: Checks that <ul>/<ol> elements only have <li>, <script>, or <template> as direct children.

checksResults.title: Listboxes have an accessible name
checksResults.description: Checks that elements with role="listbox" expose a non-empty accessible name.

checksResults.title: List items must be inside a list container
checksResults.description: Checks that <li> elements are contained by <ul>, <ol>, <menu>, or an element with role="list".

occurrences.summary: Manual review: keyboard navigation and focus order
occurrences.hint: Tab through the page and check that every interactive element can be reached and used with the keyboard, in an order that follows the page, with the focus always visible.

checksResults.title: Manual review: keyboard navigation and focus order
checksResults.description: Flags that a manual review of keyboard navigation and focus order is required.

checksResults.title: Time-based media: transcript or text alternative evidence
checksResults.description: Finds audio and video elements where a transcript or other text alternative is not strongly evidenced in the page content. This rule is conservative and reports cantTell when evidence is missing or cannot be verified.

checksResults.title: Menu items have an accessible name
checksResults.description: Checks that menu items (role="menuitem*", including checkbox/radio variants) expose a non-empty accessible name.

checksResults.title: Page must not use a timed meta refresh (AAA)
checksResults.description: Checks that <meta http-equiv="refresh"> does not set a positive delay, however long; an immediate redirect (delay 0) passes. This is the stricter AAA-level counterpart of the A-level check, which exempts delays over 20 hours.

checksResults.title: Page must not use a timed meta refresh
checksResults.description: Checks that <meta http-equiv="refresh"> does not impose a positive delay of 20 hours or less.

checksResults.title: Viewport meta tag should allow zooming up to 500%
checksResults.description: Checks that <meta name="viewport"> does not set user-scalable=no or maximum-scale below 5 (500%).

checksResults.title: Viewport meta tag must not disable zoom
checksResults.description: Checks that <meta name="viewport"> does not set user-scalable=no or maximum-scale below 2 (200%).

checksResults.title: Meters have an accessible name
checksResults.description: Checks that elements with role="meter" expose a non-empty accessible name.

checksResults.title: Pointer-only inline event handlers should have a keyboard-reachable equivalent
checksResults.description: Flags elements with an inline pointer-only event handler (onmouseover, onmouseout, onmousedown, onmouseup, ondblclick, onmousemove, onmouseenter, onmouseleave) and no keyboard-reachable equivalent (onkeydown/onkeyup/onkeypress/onfocus/onblur), for manual review.

checksResults.title: Interactive controls must not be nested
checksResults.description: Checks that an interactive control (link, button, form control, or ARIA widget role) does not contain another interactive control.

checksResults.title: Autoplaying audio should provide a pause/stop or volume-control mechanism
checksResults.description: Flags <audio>/<video> elements that autoplay unmuted with no native controls attribute, and <embed>, <object> or <bgsound> elements that may play sound, for manual review against the 3-second exemption in WCAG 1.4.2.

checksResults.title: <object> must provide a text alternative
checksResults.description: Checks that <object> elements provide a text alternative via fallback content or an accessible name.

checksResults.title: <object> text alternative must be appropriate (manual review)
checksResults.description: Flags <object> elements with detected fallback or name for human review of equivalence and appropriateness.

checksResults.title: Options have an accessible name
checksResults.description: Checks that elements with role="option" expose a non-empty accessible name.

checksResults.title: Text styled to look like a heading should probably be a real heading
checksResults.description:
Flags short

and

elements whose text is all bold and rendered at >=18px, for manual review of whether a real heading element should be used instead.

occurrences.summary: This page has no level-one heading.
occurrences.hint: Add a level-one heading (<h1> or role="heading" aria-level="1") that identifies the page's main content.

checksResults.title: Page should have a level-one heading
checksResults.description: Checks that the page has at least one level-one heading (<h1> or role="heading" with aria-level="1").

occurrences.summary: The page title is very short and may not identify the page topic or purpose.
occurrences.hint: Review the page title and ensure it clearly identifies the page topic or purpose and helps distinguish the page from others.

checksResults.title: Page title patterns that may be insufficiently descriptive
checksResults.description: Identifies page title patterns that may indicate low descriptiveness, such as generic, duplicated, or overly templated titles. This rule provides review signals and does not fail automatically.

checksResults.title: Page has a non-empty title
checksResults.description: Checks that the page includes a non-empty <title> element.

checksResults.title: Authentication fields must not block pasting
checksResults.description: Checks that a password or one-time-code field carries no inline paste handler that cancels the paste, which would remove the password manager or clipboard that WCAG 3.3.8 relies on as the assisting mechanism.

checksResults.title: Presentational role must not conflict with a global ARIA attribute or focusability
checksResults.description: Checks that role="presentation"/"none" (including an implicit presentation role) is not combined with a global ARIA attribute (aria-label, aria-hidden, aria-describedby, ...) or focusability (tabindex/native).

checksResults.title: Roles with presentational children must not contain focusable content
checksResults.description: Checks that an element whose role makes its children presentational (button, checkbox, img, option, radio, slider, switch, tab, ...) contains no descendant that takes a tab stop.

checksResults.title: Progress bars have an accessible name
checksResults.description: Checks that elements with role="progressbar" expose a non-empty accessible name.

checksResults.title: Page content should be inside a landmark region
checksResults.description: Checks that content under <body> is contained within a landmark region.

checksResults.title: [role="img"/"graphics-symbol"/"graphics-document"] must have an accessible text alternative
checksResults.description: Checks that elements with role="img", "graphics-symbol" or "graphics-document" provide an accessible text alternative using aria-label, aria-labelledby, a title attribute, or (for SVG elements) a child <title>.

checksResults.title: scope attribute must have a valid value
checksResults.description: Checks that scope="..." is one of row, col, rowgroup, or colgroup.

checksResults.title: Scrollable regions with no focusable content should be keyboard-focusable
checksResults.description: Flags elements whose CSS declares overflow:auto/scroll, contain no focusable descendant, and are not themselves keyboard-focusable, for manual review of whether their content actually overflows and needs keyboard scroll access.

checksResults.title: Searchboxes have an accessible name
checksResults.description: Checks that elements with role="searchbox" expose a non-empty accessible name.

checksResults.title: Server-side image maps must have a keyboard-operable alternative
checksResults.description: Asks, for each inside a link, whether the page offers the same destinations as links a keyboard can reach, since a server-side image map has no keyboard-operable regions of its own.

checksResults.title: Skip link must have a resolvable, usable target
checksResults.description: Checks that a "skip to ..." link's href fragment resolves to a real, currently usable element in the document.

checksResults.title: Sliders have an accessible name
checksResults.description: Checks that elements with role="slider" expose a non-empty accessible name. A native <input type="range"> is checked by form-control-programmatic-label-present.

checksResults.title: Spinbuttons have an accessible name
checksResults.description: Checks that elements with role="spinbutton" expose a non-empty accessible name.

checksResults.title: Summary elements have an accessible name
checksResults.description: Checks that <summary> elements expose a non-empty accessible name.

checksResults.title: SVG <image> must have a text alternative
checksResults.description: Checks that SVG <image> elements provide a text alternative via <title>/<desc> or an ARIA accessible name.

checksResults.title: <svg> must provide a text alternative
checksResults.description: Checks that inline <svg> elements provide a text alternative via a <title> element or an ARIA name (a <desc> element alone does not count).

checksResults.title: <svg> text alternative must be appropriate (manual review)
checksResults.description: Flags applicable <svg> graphics with a detected text alternative for human review of appropriateness.

checksResults.title: Tabs have an accessible name
checksResults.description: Checks that elements with role="tab" expose a non-empty accessible name.

checksResults.title: tabindex should not be greater than 0
checksResults.description: Checks that tabindex values are 0 or negative, not a positive number.

checksResults.title: Table caption must not duplicate its summary attribute
checksResults.description: Checks that a <table>'s <caption> text is not identical to its (deprecated) summary attribute.

checksResults.title: A table's first row should not stand in for a real <caption>
checksResults.description: Flags tables with no <caption> whose first row has a single non-empty cell while other rows have multiple cells, for manual review of whether that cell is acting as a fake caption.

checksResults.title: Table cell "headers" attribute must reference valid header cells
checksResults.description: Checks that each id in a <td>/<th> headers attribute resolves to a cell (<td> or <th>) within the same table (not missing, not a non-cell element, not itself).

checksResults.title: <th> elements must describe at least one data cell
checksResults.description: Checks that a table containing <th> elements also contains at least one <td> data cell for those headers to describe.

checksResults.title: Pointer targets must be at least 24x24px large, or leave sufficient distance to other targets
checksResults.description: Checks that pointer-operable targets have an effective hit region of at least 24 by 24 CSS pixels, or meet an allowed exception (e.g. sufficient spacing).

checksResults.title: Data cells in large tables must have an associated header
checksResults.description: Checks that every <td> in a large, simple (no colspan/rowspan) table has an associated header, via a headers attribute, an implicit column <th> above it, or an implicit row <th> to its left.

checksResults.title: Text stays readable when the user increases text spacing
checksResults.description: Applies the WCAG 1.4.12 text spacing in the browser and checks that no text is cut off or made to overlap, and asks about style sheet rules that force spacing with !important.

checksResults.title: Textboxes have an accessible name
checksResults.description: Checks that elements with role="textbox" expose a non-empty accessible name.

checksResults.title: Tooltips have an accessible name
checksResults.description: Checks that elements with role="tooltip" expose a non-empty accessible name.

checksResults.title: Tree items have an accessible name
checksResults.description: Checks that elements with role="treeitem" expose a non-empty accessible name.

checksResults.title: Element lang attribute must be syntactically valid
checksResults.description: Checks that any element (other than the root <html>) with a non-empty lang attribute uses a syntactically valid language tag.

checksResults.title: Prerecorded video should provide a captions track
checksResults.description: Flags <video> elements with no <track kind="captions"> child, for manual review of whether the video has an audio track that needs captions; a subtitles track alone may be a translation only.

checksResults.title: <video> poster must have a text alternative
checksResults.description: Checks that <video> elements with a poster image provide a text alternative (accessible name).

rulesResults.title: Non-text content: text alternatives
rulesResults.description: Rollup of checks ensuring non-text content has an appropriate text alternative.

rulesResults.title: Audio-only and video-only (prerecorded): transcript
rulesResults.description: Rollup of checks for transcript availability for prerecorded audio-only/video-only media.

rulesResults.title: Captions (Prerecorded)
rulesResults.description: Rollup of checks for captions-track evidence on prerecorded video.

rulesResults.title: Info and Relationships
rulesResults.description: Rollup of checks ensuring information, structure, and relationships conveyed through presentation are programmatically determinable.

rulesResults.title: Use of Color
rulesResults.description: Rollup of checks ensuring color is not used as the only visual means of conveying information.

rulesResults.title: Audio Control
rulesResults.description: Rollup of checks for a pause/stop or volume-control mechanism on autoplaying audio.

rulesResults.title: Contrast: minimum
rulesResults.description: Rollup of checks for minimum text contrast.

rulesResults.title: Contrast: enhanced
rulesResults.description: Rollup of checks for enhanced text contrast.

rulesResults.title: Keyboard
rulesResults.description: Rollup of checks ensuring functionality is operable through a keyboard interface.

rulesResults.title: Keyboard (No Exception)
rulesResults.description: Rollup of checks ensuring functionality is operable through a keyboard interface with no exceptions (AAA).

rulesResults.title: Pause, Stop, Hide
rulesResults.description: Rollup of checks ensuring moving, blinking, or auto-scrolling content can be paused, stopped, or hidden.

rulesResults.title: Bypass Blocks
rulesResults.description: Rollup of checks ensuring the page provides a way to bypass repeated blocks of content.

rulesResults.title: Page titled
rulesResults.description: Rollup of checks ensuring documents have a meaningful page title.

rulesResults.title: Focus order
rulesResults.description: Rollup of checks ensuring focus moves through content in a meaningful order.

rulesResults.title: Link Purpose (In Context)
rulesResults.description: Rollup of checks flagging links with no accessible name, or whose text alone is a known non-descriptive/generic phrase.

rulesResults.title: Headings and Labels
rulesResults.description: Rollup of checks flagging headings whose text is a placeholder rather than a description of the content that follows.

rulesResults.title: Focus visible
rulesResults.description: Rollup of checks ensuring keyboard focus is not hidden and remains perceivable.

rulesResults.title: Link Purpose (Link Only)
rulesResults.description: Rollup of checks ensuring links with the same accessible name serve the same purpose (AAA).

rulesResults.title: Label in name
rulesResults.description: Rollup of checks ensuring that when a control has a visible text label, the accessible name contains that visible label text.

rulesResults.title: Target size: minimum
rulesResults.description: Rollup of checks ensuring pointer targets meet minimum size requirements.

rulesResults.title: Language of page
rulesResults.description: Rollup of checks ensuring the page language is specified.

rulesResults.title: Language of Parts
rulesResults.description: Rollup of checks ensuring elements whose language differs from the page default declare it correctly.

rulesResults.title: Orientation
rulesResults.description: Rollup of checks ensuring content does not restrict its view to a single display orientation.

rulesResults.title: Identify Input Purpose
rulesResults.description: Rollup of checks ensuring the autocomplete attribute correctly identifies input purpose.

rulesResults.title: Text Spacing
rulesResults.description: Rollup of checks ensuring text spacing can be increased without losing content.

rulesResults.title: Interruptions
rulesResults.description: Rollup of checks ensuring automatic context changes only happen at the user's request (AAA).

rulesResults.title: Change on Request
rulesResults.description: Rollup of checks ensuring context changes only happen at the user's request (AAA).

rulesResults.title: Parsing
rulesResults.description: Rollup of checks ensuring id values are unique. WCAG 2.0/2.1 only: SC 4.1.1 was removed in WCAG 2.2, so this composite carries the wcag22-removed tag.

rulesResults.title: Name, role, value: accessible name
rulesResults.description: Rollup of checks that common interactive elements expose a non-empty accessible name.

rulesResults.title: Name, role, value: ARIA validity
rulesResults.description: Rollup of checks that ARIA role and attribute usage conforms to the WAI-ARIA specification (valid roles, valid attributes, valid values, required attributes, unique ARIA-referenced ids).

rulesResults.title: Resize Text
rulesResults.description: Rollup of checks ensuring the viewport meta tag does not prevent users from zooming text up to 200%.

rulesResults.title: Timing Adjustable
rulesResults.description: Rollup of checks ensuring the page does not impose a timed refresh the user cannot control.

rulesResults.title: Labels or Instructions
rulesResults.description: Rollup of checks ensuring form controls have unambiguous labeling.

rulesResults.title: Accessible Authentication (Minimum)
rulesResults.description: Rollup of checks ensuring an authentication step leaves the mechanisms that help a user through it in place.
